name.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

git_remote_settings.description: Optional. If set, configures this repository to be linked to a Git remote. Structure is [documented below](#nested_git_remote_settings).
git_remote_settings.rationale: Git remote settings affect repository access control and authentication security.

url.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

default_branch.description: The Git remote's default branch name.
default_branch.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

authentication_token_secret_version.description: The name of the Secret Manager secret version to use as an authentication token for Git operations. This secret is for assigning with HTTPS only(for SSH use `ssh_authentication_config`). Must be in the format projects/*/secrets/*/versions/*.
authentication_token_secret_version.rationale: Authentication tokens must be properly managed through Secret Manager to prevent unauthorized access to Git repositories.

ssh_authentication_config.description: Authentication fields for remote uris using SSH protocol. Structure is [documented below](#nested_git_remote_settings_ssh_authentication_config).
ssh_authentication_config.rationale: SSH authentication configuration affects access control to Git repositories and must be properly secured.

token_status.description: (Output) Indicates the status of the Git access token. https://cloud.google.com/dataform/reference/rest/v1beta1/projects.locations.repositories#TokenStatus
token_status.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

workspace_compilation_overrides.description: If set, fields of workspaceCompilationOverrides override the default compilation settings that are specified in dataform.json when creating workspace-scoped compilation results. Structure is [documented below](#nested_workspace_compilation_overrides).
workspace_compilation_overrides.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

default_database.description: The default database (Google Cloud project ID).
default_database.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

schema_suffix.description: The suffix that should be appended to all schema (BigQuery dataset ID) names.
schema_suffix.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

table_prefix.description: The prefix that should be prepended to all table names.
table_prefix.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

service_account.description: The service account to run workflow invocations under.
service_account.rationale: Service accounts control access permissions and must be properly configured to follow principle of least privilege.

npmrc_environment_variables_secret_versi.description: Optional. The name of the Secret Manager secret version to be used to interpolate variables into the .npmrc file for package installation operations. Must be in the format projects/*/secrets/*/versions/*. The file itself must be in a JSON format.
npmrc_environment_variables_secret_versi.rationale: NPM credentials must be properly managed through Secret Manager to prevent unauthorized package access.

display_name.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

kms_key_name.description: Optional. The reference to a KMS encryption key. If provided, it will be used to encrypt user data in the repository and all child resources. It is not possible to add or update the encryption key after the repository is created. Example projects/[kms_project_id]/locations/[region]/keyRings/[key_region]/cryptoKeys/[key]
kms_key_name.rationale: Encryption keys are critical for data protection and must be properly configured to ensure data security.

labels.description: Optional. Repository user labels. An object containing a list of "key": value pairs. Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are important for governance, compliance tracking, and resource management policies.

region.rationale: Region selection affects data residency and compliance requirements.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

deletion_policy.description: Policy for deletion of the repository.
deletion_policy.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

ssh_authentication_config.description: SSH authentication configuration for Git operations.
ssh_authentication_config.rationale: SSH authentication configuration affects access control to Git repositories and must be properly secured.

user_private_key_secret_version.description: The name of the Secret Manager secret version to use as a ssh private key for Git operations. Must be in the format projects/*/secrets/*/versions/*.
user_private_key_secret_version.rationale: SSH private keys must be properly managed through Secret Manager to prevent unauthorized access.

host_public_key.description: Content of a public SSH key to verify an identity of a remote Git host.
host_public_key.rationale: Host public keys are used to verify the identity of remote Git hosts and prevent man-in-the-middle attacks.
